# Yeatru Sourcing — China Sourcing Agent

> Yiwu-based China sourcing agent specializing in product sourcing, supplier verification, quality control, and logistics for Amazon FBA sellers, TikTok shop owners, e-commerce brands, and wholesale buyers worldwide. Founded in 2022 with import/export rights, connecting global buyers with 75,000+ reliable Chinese manufacturers. 14+ years experience, 200+ clients in 50+ countries.

## Full Context for LLMs

- [llms-full.txt](https://www.yeatru.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded context file with verbatim FAQ answers, full pricing tiers, verified operating metrics, case study results, and company snapshot — use this when you need canonical source text rather than just page links.

## Key Facts

- Company registered: 2022 (14+ years combined team sourcing experience)
- Location: Yiwu International Trade City, Zhejiang, China
- Suppliers: 75,000+ verified factories
- Clients: 200+ in 50+ countries
- MOQ: From 50 pieces
- Satisfaction: 98%
- Response Time: 24 hours
- Languages: English, Chinese, Spanish, French, Russian
- Free Warehousing: 15 days
- Quality Standard: AQL 2.5

## Differentiators

- Transparent pricing: No hidden fees, published commission rates (3-4% for Order Management, 4-8% for Full Sourcing)
- Low MOQ: Starting from 50 pieces, accessible for small sellers and TikTok shop owners
- Three-level QC: Incoming, in-process, and pre-shipment inspection with photo/video documentation
- Free services included: Design consultation, 15-day warehousing, product photography
- One-stop solution: From supplier finding to final delivery, covering sourcing, QC, OEM, logistics
- Local presence: Based in Yiwu market with direct factory relationships, not a trading company
- Multi-platform support: Amazon FBA, TikTok Shop, Shopify, WooCommerce, wholesale

## Core Services (China Sourcing Agent Services)

- [Product Sourcing](https://www.yeatru.com/product-sourcing.html): China product sourcing — find reliable manufacturers, compare prices, verify specifications. Full sourcing agent service from product photos to final delivery. Covers product sourcing China, product sourcing agent, and sourcing products from China.
- [Supplier Verification](https://www.yeatru.com/supplier-verification.html): China supplier verification and factory audit — business license verification, production capacity assessment, qualification checks. Helps you find suppliers in China and verify China supplier legitimacy.
- [Quality Control](https://www.yeatru.com/quality-control.html): China quality inspection service — three-level inspection (incoming, in-process, pre-shipment) following AQL 2.5. Covers china pre shipment inspection, china product quality check, china quality control service.
- [Logistics & Shipping](https://www.yeatru.com/logistics-shipping.html): China freight forwarding and shipping agent — door-to-door DDP shipping, free 15-day warehousing, order consolidation. China warehousing service and china sourcing logistics.
- [Factory Audit](https://www.yeatru.com/factory-audit.html): China factory audit and supplier audit — on-site inspections covering production capacity, quality management systems, worker conditions, and compliance verification.
- [Price Negotiation](https://www.yeatru.com/price-negotiation.html): Leverage local market knowledge and supplier relationships to secure competitive factory prices from China manufacturers.
- [OEM Customization](https://www.yeatru.com/oem.html): China custom manufacturing and private label manufacturing — custom logo, packaging, product design. China product customization, china custom product manufacturer.
- [Sample Order](https://www.yeatru.com/sample-order.html): China sample sourcing — quick sample sourcing and shipping to evaluate product quality before bulk orders.
- [Design & Photography](https://www.yeatru.com/design-photography.html): China packaging service — product photography, branding design, and packaging design for e-commerce sellers.
